task_name: The activity of the current implementation call
summary: Added ImplementationActivities port, the ImplementationActivity value object, and StreamImplementationActivities (picks the `implementation` call with the latest startedAt from calls.history(watch.agent), reads its stream.ndjson through a fresh StreamCursors/StreamLine pass with no cross-poll caching, and answers null tool/text when the stream file does not exist yet). Made StreamCursors and StreamLine `export` in stream-planning-activities.ts (only those two keywords changed) so the new adapter reuses the same parsing without duplicating it. Added ImplementationActivityFailure/NotRead to exceptions.ts, additive only. TDD: wrote the 4 named tests first, watched them fail on the missing module, implemented, then ran both verification commands green. A hand mutation sweep found one real gap the plan's own worked example did not: 'always take the first implementation call' passed every named test undetected, because the plan's TDD example happens to list the later call first. I added one more test, `it('the current implementation call is chosen by startedAt, not by its position in the history')`, with the earlier call listed first — that mutation now dies for the right reason. Two other mutations (filtering by 'plan' instead of 'implementation', ignoring the stream contents) were already caught. This is the one deviation from the plan's exact **Tests:** list; flagging it here since testing.md's mutation-sweep rule left no other repair (the comparison line is needed, so the missing coverage was the defect, not the line).
